head: codex/5615-csdlc-ci-fastwork-routing
title: [v0.91.8][CI] Require truthful C-SDLC v2 and Runtime validation routing
body:
Closes #5615

Repairs CI classification so C-SDLC v2 Rust changes run their standalone test, format, and strict-Clippy proof, lifecycle metadata alone remains lightweight, and mixed Runtime v3 plus C-SDLC v2 changes require both focused lanes. Stable aggregation fails closed when a selected standalone lane is skipped or malformed. Cargo validation state is routed to a validated external build root with child-symlink escape rejection.

The hosted workflow parser exposed an invalid job-level runner.temp expression. The corrected reviewed head now initializes the external root from RUNNER_TEMP inside a run step and exports it through GITHUB_ENV. Focused YAML, classifier, Runtime, selector, workflow, and external-root contracts pass; exact re-review passed with zero findings.
